extracted.intended_audience: database researchers, VLDB conference authors/reviewers, VLDB community members and stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational/homepage information describing the VLDB Endowment's purpose, governance, relationship to PVLDB and the VLDB conference review process, publishing activities, sponsored programs, archives, and an explicit position on racism and inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Endowment purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Promoting and exchanging scholarly work in databases and related fields throughout the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organization is a non-profit incorporated in the United States for the sole purpose of promoting and exchanging scholarly work in databases and related fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role as steering committee for VLDB conference series
rubrics_metrics.description: The Endowment serves as the steering committee for the VLDB conference series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Governance and high-level stewardship of the VLDB conferences are the Endowment's responsibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference review process via PVLDB
rubrics_metrics.description: The review process for these conferences is implemented in collaboration with PVLDB and the conference review process is entirely through PVLDB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All aspects of conference submission/review are routed through PVLDB (i.e., PVLDB handles the review workflow); stakeholders should follow PVLDB procedures for conference reviews and submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: VLDB Journal as archival venue
rubrics_metrics.description: Since 1992, the Endowment has published the VLDB Journal for disseminating archival research results; the journal is one of the most successful journals across computer science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The VLDB Journal is an archival publication (published in collaboration with Springer-Verlag) intended for archival-quality research dissemination; authors seeking archival publication should consult the VLDB Journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsorship of scholarly and training activities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Endowment sponsors various scholarly activities and has established a program that supports summer schools and other training activities in countries that could otherwise not afford expenses for such events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Endowment supports community capacity-building and training initiatives, especially in lower-resource settings; proposals and activities aimed at education/training may seek Endowment support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance of historical archives and transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: The VLDB historical archives since 1995 contain web sites of past conferences, conference statistics (e.g., number of papers submitted, acceptance rates), and other useful information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Past conference materials and statistics are preserved and made available to the community for transparency and historical reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance structure
rubrics_metrics.description: The VLDB Endowment is governed by a Board of Trustees consisting of 21 members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level organizational decisions are made by the Board of Trustees; governance composition and oversight are explicitly stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: VLDB position on racism and inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: The VLDB Endowment is committed to ensuring all VLDB activities are carried out in an inclusive and diverse environment with zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, or any other form of misconduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commitments and actions include: acknowledging the existence of racism within communities and committing to defeating it; calling out and rejecting rationalization and distortion of information; educating ourselves and others to address racism; standing up against the status quo by using voice and agency; inviting the community to discuss concrete steps to create lasting change. The Endowment explicitly states it will not be satisfied with the status quo and will actively stand against discrimination.
